advices.diagnosis: The ReportView class shows low cohesion (LCOM4 = 2) and a high dependency count (DCC = 2), indicating that it mixes responsibilities of presentation, data access, and email sending. The feature‑envy smell is also evident: the class accesses Customer attributes far more than its own state. This violates the presentation layer’s contract of not importing infrastructure components directly.

suggestions.title: Introduce an OrderReportService in the application layer
notes: addresses_smells names labels the target does not carry: low_cohesion

advices.risk_notes: The refactor requires updating all call sites to pass an OrderReportService instance instead of separate repository and mailer objects. Tests that mock the repository or mailer directly will need adjustment. If the application layer already contains a suitable service, this change may duplicate functionality; otherwise, creating the service adds a new dependency that must be wired in the composition root.
